firstPassFailures.refused props that RN's own components i: the first classification refused focusable (TouchableWithoutFeedback), accessibilityValue (TouchableNativeFeedback) and onFocusCapture (VirtualizedList cells); test:touchables, test:lists, test:examples and test:os-contracts failed. They became ignored by decision, registered as a divergence
firstPassFailures.stale controls in build/: controls and sabotage reports of other slices (animated, images, images-network, images-visual, frame-clock, networking, websocket) failed 'the same bundle runs on every host' after the host was rebuilt for the merge of main; they were moved to build/stale-by-frontier-scope/ and the lanes rerun green
firstPassFailures.the control host: the first previous-lane run died at supportedOrientations: true, which the host of main refuses from inside the mount; the Modal props the host refuses itself are skipped in that lane only
firstPassFailures.the scroll sabotage: the crash of the host made the lane read the sabotage as 'not rejected'; a run that leaves no report and has Program crashed in the log now counts as rejected

implementationPinVerification.method: git show <implementationCommit>:<path> SHA-256 equals the SHA-256 of the file in the tree the lanes ran from

departuresFromRN: Props that RN's own components inject into a public View (focusable, accessibilityValue, onFocusCapture and the rest of the accessibility and focus props) are ignored by decision instead of refused, so that RN's touchables and lists keep working (docs/research/accessibility.md)
The ScrollView accepts the host-neutral request of a behavior prop it cannot honor (bounces false), not RN's default (true on iOS), as the original ScrollView of #58 did
A hover prop on the Pressable fails with 'Godot Pressable does not implement onHoverIn/onHoverOut', the text of every refusal, and no longer with 'hover events are not implemented yet'
limits: The execution this record describes is local, macOS arm64 and headless; the hosted CI run and the Pages publication of main b0e40aa (the squash of PR #74) are recorded in hosted-ci.json and publication.json (see hostedCI); the Pages artifact had expired, so the deployed migration.json was not compared
No screenshot: the slice has no visual output, and no pixel is compared
Nothing was compared with an iOS device or simulator; the decisions follow RN's pinned sources, not a differential
The retained scroll sabotage ends in a host crash, so the cases after the 40th ScrollView refusal were not driven under it
The control depends on the host of main having been built from the committed sources of e1c7a39 and on the same host running both lanes
No 1.0 checkpoint, weight or denominator moves; the dashboard is not edited by this record
